source: USDA NASS Census of Agriculture, bulk files qs.census2017.txt.gz / qs.census2022.txt.gz
access_note: public bulk files, no API key
filter: COMMODITY_DESC=SOYBEANS; STATE_ALPHA=IN; PRODN_PRACTICE_DESC contains IRRIGATED; STATISTICCAT_DESC=AREA HARVESTED
note: Census disclosure suppression withholds irrigated acreage for counties below a threshold; irrigated_frac_avg understates true share for those counties, flagged in any_suppressed rather than imputed.
